title.suggested: Notice for Tom Allen's Saloon at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, 'retired champion pugilist of the world,' at 619 Market Street: free concert every evening, best of singers only.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, January 30, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen advertised himself as 'retired champion pugilist of the world' at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with free concerts every evening

notes: Duplicate of 833: same notice, same page (Globe-Democrat, Jan 30, 1892, p. 7). Human should decide whether to remove one. Summary said 'heavyweight' and 'concert house', neither in the text.
